text:
Tara: Quick thread for the mini-design-partner run we'll pitch tomorrow. Need: recruitment filters, 3-week scope, what we promise vs not, success signals, and a rollback plan. Target 6 partners. Short takes pls.
Ethan: Recruitment filters: product teams with a clear internal ticket + ability to route 5-10% of traffic; prefer hosted/VPC customers. Avoid heavy-regulated customers for this small run. Incentive: $500 credits + 2 office hours + a final perf report.
Ravi: Ops constraints: hosted and VPC only. Must have per-org token caps, model-variant pinning, and a per-route feature flag for rollback. Require an expected_peak_concurrency field in intake so SRE can size KV/cache. We'll auto-warn at 80% and auto-fallback to a cheaper model if partner exceeds budget.
Lena: Feedback loop: partners must provide a 30-example canonical set + 10 labeled edge cases. We'll run nightly diffs and surface a weekly "delta deck." Provide a tiny in-console labeling widget to capture triage notes. Also require partners to run the exportable eval within 48h of onboarding.
Tara: Scope negotiation: promise telemetry dashboard, model pinning, token budgets, exportable evals, and weekly syncs. Do NOT promise kernel tuning, custom quantization, or on-prem support. Rollback must be instant via feature flag.
Ethan: Success signals proposal:
- Activation: >=66% partners send traffic within first 7 days
- Quality: <=10% of partners show >5% degradation on baseline eval
- Value: >=2 partners report measurable latency or cost improvement in post-pilot survey
- Commercial: >=25% express interest in next-phase (Dedicated / Private) or file a roadmap ask
Ravi: Implementation notes: add intake fields: expected_eval_examples_count, expected_peak_concurrency, retention_days_for_logs. Action items:
- Ravi: implement feature-flag + 80% warn webhook (ETA: EOD)
- Lena: produce eval template + small labeling UI mock (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Ethan: draft outreach copy + shortlist 8 targets (ETA: today EOD)
- Tara: slide for roadmap review (ETA: tomorrow)
pilot-bot: forms-publish: mini-dp-intake v1 posted to /internal/pilot-forms (status: success)
Tara: If no objections to hosted/VPC-only and incentive level I'll lock this copy and start outreach. :white_check_mark:
